a: Encode differently for HTML body, attributes, JS, CSS, and URLs.
Do not build JS with raw user strings; use safe APIs/JSON serialization.
DOM XSS happens when JS writes untrusted data into dangerous sinks.
innerHTML, document.write, eval, and some URL assignments are risky.
CSP reduces XSS impact by restricting script sources.
Trusted Types help prevent DOM XSS by restricting sink assignments.
Sanitize rendered Markdown/HTML with a vetted sanitizer.
SVG can contain scripts; sanitize or serve as downloads.
React escapes text by default; avoid dangerous HTML injection APIs.
